Welcome to 7600 Palladium Loop in Killeen, TX 76542 — a beautifully upgraded single-story home with move-in ready value and tons of smart features you won’t find in a typical new build! This Carothers-built corner-lot property offers:

✨ 4 bedrooms • 2.5 bathrooms • Dedicated office
✨ Formal dining room + open floor plan perfect for everyday living & entertaining
✨ Chef-inspired kitchen with upgraded countertops & farmhouse sink
✨ Fully equipped outdoor kitchen & covered patio — ideal for BBQs and outdoor living
✨ 3-car garage with finished floors & built-in storage
✨ Smart home upgrades: smart thermostat, blinds, security system included
✨ Appliances included — saving you thousands upfront
✨ Structural builder’s warranty still in place
✨ Fenced backyard with privacy fence — great for kids and pets
✨ Premium upgrades throughout — designed for comfort and lifestyle

📍 Located in Heritage Oaks this home blends value, style, and practicality in one of Killeen’s sought-after neighborhoods — just minutes from schools, shopping, and I-14/FM Corridor access.
